sources.name: Citizen Lab
sources.focus: Landmark research on targeted spyware and digital threats against civil society, journalists, and activists.

sources.name: Amnesty International Security Lab
sources.focus: Forensic investigations of spyware attacks, plus open tooling to help people check their own devices.

sources.name: EFF Deeplinks
sources.focus: Continuous reporting on surveillance, license-plate readers, and digital rights from the Electronic Frontier Foundation.

sources.name: 404 Media — Flock coverage

sources.name: DeFlock

sources.name: Surveillance Watch
sources.focus: An interactive map exposing the surveillance-technology industry and the money behind it.

sources.name: Atlas of Surveillance
sources.focus: A searchable database of surveillance tech deployed by US law enforcement.

sources.name: OONI
sources.focus: Data-driven findings on internet censorship and network interference from around the world.

sources.name: Access Now
